name: Beechcraft Staggerwing (Model 17)
variants: Model 17 variants with Jacobs, Wright or Wasp Junior engines
summary: 1930s luxury cabin biplane with unmistakable negative stagger; fast and elegant, with about 785 built and a devoted survivor community.

wings: Biplane with negative stagger: the lower wing sits ahead of the upper wing
Upper and lower wings are of similar size
engines: Single round radial engine under a smooth cowl
fuselage: Fully enclosed cabin with a steeply raked windscreen
Retractable main gear with a fixed tailwheel
tail: Single tall fin and rounded rudder with a tailwheel

tellTales: Biplane whose lower wing sits ahead of the upper wing
Enclosed cabin with a steeply raked windscreen under a biplane wing stack
Cowled radial and retractable main gear on a biplane

confusedWith.howToTell: The Waco cabin biplane has the upper wing forward, a small stub lower wing and fixed spatted gear; the Staggerwing has the lower wing forward and retractable gear.
The Reliant is a high-wing monoplane; the Staggerwing has two wings with the lower one forward.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
